entries.en: thin copper wire; fine copper thread

entries.zh: 柑橘果瓣上的白色细丝络膜〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: fine threads/pith-membrane of the mandarin orange on its segments (headword partly damaged)
entries.notes: 西语词头中段缺损（g[残]nela）且一调 T99；据汉字“柑膜”与音写 cám boÿ / căm mò 推定为柑瓣白色络丝，gojos 疑为 gajos（果瓣）。

entries.en: row, file, rank (of people or things)

entries.zh: 人群排成行堆；列队成群
entries.en: rows of people; people drawn up in massed ranks

entries.zh: 人群排成行；列成一长串
entries.en: rows of people; people in one continuous line
rows of people; people arranged in stacked rows
rank/file of soldiers; soldiers drawn up in rows
entries.notes: 音写第二音节调号污损（T99）；汉字“行偶”按同音疑即“行伍”借字，义为士兵行列。

entries.zh: 排班；（官吏）在官长前依序列班
entries.en: to line up in order of duty; officials ranged in ranks before the mandarin
to drive/pound (a stake etc.) into the ground
entries.notes: 汉字“琢”与音写 tō 对应存疑（疑为“捣”类字之误写/形近），按西语 hincar en el suelo 释义。
首汉字带[疑]（掙/插），按音写 chā（tsâ）与西语取“插”义。

entries.en: to bend the knee as a courtesy; kneeling salute

entries.zh: 插篙、立杆（如于水中）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to plant/stick in a pole or staff (Spanish head-phrase garbled; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头语句杂乱难解（fembra、dion 等无法复原），两汉字均带[疑]；据“插/篙”与音写 chā-co 推定为插立篙杆。

entries.en: to stick/drive in well; insert firmly
entries.notes: 首汉字带[疑]（掙/插），据西语 hincar bien 与音写 chā xip（tsâ-ji̍p）取“插入”义。

entries.en: to prick, stab, pierce (as with a dart)
entries.notes: 西语词头中 acadon、dardillon 未获确解（疑为镖枪/标枪类器名），据汉字“刺”与音写 chŷ 定为刺、戳。
